title: Drone Surveillance Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Professional template for requesting drone surveillance information from authorities or organizations. Protect your privacy rights with this ready-to-use letter.
description: A comprehensive letter template for requesting information about drone surveillance activities in your area. This template helps you exercise your right to know about aerial surveillance operations affecting your privacy and property.

sections.heading: Subject and Introduction
sections.content:
Subject: Request for Information Regarding Drone Surveillance Activities

Dear [Recipient Name],

I am writing to request information about drone surveillance operations conducted by your organization in [Location/Area] between [Start Date] and [End Date]. As a [Property Owner/Resident/Concerned Citizen], I am exercising my right to understand surveillance activities that may affect my privacy.

sections.heading: Specific Information Requested
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following information:

1. Records of all drone surveillance flights in the [Specific Area] during the specified timeframe
2. Purpose and legal authority for each surveillance operation
3. Types of data collected (video, photos, thermal imaging, etc.)
4. Duration of data retention and storage policies
5. Policies governing drone surveillance operations
6. Notification procedures for affected residents
7. Any sharing of collected data with other agencies or entities

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Privacy Concerns
sections.content:
This request is made under [Applicable Law/FOIA/State Open Records Act]. I have specific privacy concerns regarding:

• Potential surveillance of private property at [Property Address]
• [Specific Incident or Concern]
• Impact on reasonable expectation of privacy
• Compliance with local drone regulations

I believe this information is in the public interest and necessary to ensure transparency in surveillance operations.

sections.heading: Request for Fee Waiver and Timeline
sections.content:
I request a waiver of any fees associated with this request, as the information serves the public interest in government transparency. If fees cannot be waived, please provide an estimate before proceeding.

I would appreciate a response within [Number] business days as required by law. If you cannot provide all requested information, please provide what is available and explain any exemptions claimed.

sections.heading: Contact Information and Closing
sections.content:
Please contact me at [Phone Number] or [Email Address] if you need clarification or have questions about this request. I prefer to receive responsive documents electronically to [Email Address].

I look forward to your prompt response and appreciate your cooperation in providing this important information.

Sincerely,

[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
